A_network_test.data: Martiny et al. 2025 SD3 (nodes) and SD4 (links); acquired ARG nodes only (n=55)
A_network_test.mapping_rule: exact gene match after CARD->ResFinder name normalisation; a gene maps only if it matches exactly one node; functional nodes excluded (named by clone IDs, not mappable)
A_network_test.null: 10,000 random draws of the same number of distinct nodes from all acquired ARG nodes; one-sided P=(#null>=obs+1)/10001
A_network_test.primary_statistic: fraction of pairs of distinct mapped module nodes sharing the same comm_id
A_network_test.reporting: reported in the manuscript whatever the outcome
A_network_test.secondary: density of acquired-acquired links among mapped module nodes vs the same null
A_network_test.uninformative_if: fewer than 6 distinct module nodes mapped

B_intI1_test.data: Zhu et al. 2025 Supplementary Data 3 (MGE abundances per sample)
B_intI1_test.intI1_definition: rows whose MGE_Gene_name equals 'intI1' (case-insensitive), summed per sample; if absent the test is not run
B_intI1_test.null: 9,999 permutations of intI1 values among plants within country; one-sided P
B_intI1_test.primary_statistic: mean within-country Spearman correlation with intI1 for the 45 mobile-associated genes minus that for the 69 other core genes
B_intI1_test.reporting: reported in the manuscript whatever the outcome
B_intI1_test.secondary: same statistic for the 77 label-free module genes versus the 37 genes outside the module
B_intI1_test.success_criterion: primary P<0.05 in the predicted (positive) direction
B_intI1_test.transform: plant means of log10(x + half the smallest positive value); country means removed from genes and intI1

C_depth_adjustment: Covariate analysis, not an outcome test: D recomputed after regressing each gene (plant level) on log10 HQ bases from Zhu Supplementary Data 1
